finding: A failed resource releases its concurrency permit during backoff; a queued later resource executes before its retry. Database writes and publication rollback/retry are real; the first conflict and ordering barriers are synthetic. Existing identity-bag test also assumes oldest survivor.
proposal: Retain one permit per resource through bounded transaction retries; every attempt still uses a new session and backoff holds no DB locks. No increased retry count. Verify cancellation, ownership and both databases before full gates.
